subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic channel auth contract and `openclaw channels login --phone-number`, or kept as a WhatsApp-owned entrypoint?
rationale: The remaining work is not only implementation: it adds a public CLI option, expands a plugin-facing channel auth contract, and changes persisted WhatsApp auth-state behavior.

options.title: Accept Generic Seam After Fixes
options.body: Keep the typed generic login-method contract and phone-number CLI flag, but require the Baileys fix, upgrade proof, and live WhatsApp smoke before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Surface
options.body: Rework the entrypoint so phone-code login stays local to the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel auth API.

options.title: Reject Phone-Code Support
options.body: Close this issue and associated PRs if maintainers do not want to own WhatsApp phone-code pairing volatility in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Seam After Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic login-method contract and phone-number CLI flag, but require the Baileys fix, upgrade proof, and live WhatsApp smoke before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses public CLI, plugin SDK, docs, and channel-auth boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the best routing owner.
